meta.settlement_policy: A ledger entry settles only when (1) its price record has ticker/market id + observed_utc, (2) the market's own settlement rule is recorded, and (3) the match result is confirmed on HLTV and cross-checked on Liquipedia. Conflicts block settlement.
meta.payout_formula: win: stake * decimal_odds; loss: 0; void: stake. profit = payout - stake.
meta.prediction_share_conversion: A Yes share bought at price p (0-1) converts to decimal_odds = 1 / p for ledger math; the raw share price and venue are always preserved alongside.
meta.note: Empty by policy: no verified TWC 2026 prices exist yet (see ML-030). Entries appear here only with full provenance.
